standard-dialogue.npc: Kebabs! Get your kebabs here! One gold each!

steps.npc: Yes? Are you going to give me that one gold coin then?

steps.player: Sorry, I don't seem to have any money on me.

steps.npc: The bank is Keldagrim-West. Hurry back!

options.text: I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.

steps.player: I'm looking for a drunken dwarf.

steps.text: If the player has not completed the Forgettable Tale... quest:

steps.npc: Just go out in the streets, they can't be hard to find!

steps.player: No, a specific drunken dwarf, he keeps harassing me.

steps.npc: That's still not very helpful. But let me see. There is one particularly drunken dwarf just to the northeast of here.
He's scaring away my customers, he says there's something wrong with my kebabs. Quite annoying fellow.

steps.player: I don't think that's who I mean.

steps.npc: Well, he does have a relative who wanders all over Gielinor. Comes back from time to time to buy more kebabs. Don't see him very often though.

steps.player: Do you think I'll have any chance of catching him here?

steps.npc: I think he was back here quite recently, so I doubt he'll be back any time soon.

steps.text: If the player has completed the Forgettable Tale... quest:

steps.npc: I thought you would know plenty!
Oh come on! You in the Laughing Miner? The whole city knows about you and your dwarven drinking buddies!
Not really! I have a steady supply of meat coming in through the carts and I don't really need anything else!

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-on-his-f.npc: Hey, what are you trying to put into my kebabs? Get away from there, get your own fireplace!

standard-dialogue-using-an-item-on-his-s.npc: Hey, do you mind? That's my property!
